pages.text: A cart carrying a **shulker box**: 27 slots, opened with a right-click.

**Breaking it keeps everything inside**, shown in the item's tooltip, and placing it brings them back. Like a shulker box it can't hold shulker boxes or other freight carts.

Hoppers load and unload it. An [[inspector_rail]] signals how full it is, from 1 to 15. Hitch it into a train with a [[linking_bar]].
